test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a type/kind of new media?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The question asks which of the options is NOT a type of new media.
 
• **New media** typically** refers to digital forms of communication that emerged with the advent of the internet.**
 
• This includes **web advertisements, emails, and online video streams.** **Television,** however, is considered a** traditional form of media**,** not new media.**__
 
• In summary,** option 2 (Television)** is the** correct** **answer** because **it is not a type of new media,** whereas options 1, 3, and 4 are all forms of new media.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Web advertisements:** These are a form of digital marketing and communication and are considered new media.
 
• **Emails:** Electronic mail is a digital form of communication and falls under the category of new media.
 
• **Online video streams:** Platforms like YouTube and streaming services are considered new media as they utilize the internet for content distribution.
